        between Sterlite Technologies Limited and STL Networks Limited and their respective
        shareholders and creditors under sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the
        Companies Act, 2013 (“the Scheme”)

Dear Sir/Madam,

This is in reference to the Scheme filed by the Company under Regulation 37 and Regulation 59A of the (Listing
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’) with National Stock
Exchange of India Limited (‘NSE’) on May 26, 2023 and subsequent hosting of the said Scheme, along with
other relevant documents, by NSE on its website on June 23, 2023.

As per Para I(A)(6) and Para I(A)(7) as mentioned above, the Company is inter-alia required to submit a "Report
on Complaints" containing the details of complaints received by the Company on the draft Scheme from various
sources, within 7 days of expiry of 21 days from the date of uploading of the draft Scheme and related
documents on the website of the relevant Stock Exchange.

In the present case, i.e. the Scheme, the period of 21 days from date the uploading of said documents by NSE
on its website (i.e. June 23, 2023) has expired on July 14, 2023, accordingly, we attach herewith a "Report on
Complaints", as Annexure - I to this letter.

The Report on Complaints is also being uploaded on the website of the Company, i.e. https://stl.tech/investor/
as per requirement of the aforementioned said SEBI Circulars.

We request you to take the above on record and treat the same as compliance under the applicable provisions
of the SEBI Listing Regulations and SEBI Circulars.

Thanking you,

Yours Faithfully,
For Sterlite Technologies Limited

items.title: CLSA turns cautious on Indian IT, downgrades TCS, Infosys, Tech Mahindra; prefers mid-tier stocks amid AI shift
items.summary: CLSA downgraded TCS, Infosys and Tech Mahindra to Hold and Wipro and Mphasis to Underperform, warning that AI-led deflation and macro headwinds could weigh on business. It said mid-tier firms as better placed to navigate the technology transition, retaining bullish calls on Coforge, Persistent Systems, LTIMindtree and Hexaware.

items.title: Nifty IT jumps nearly 3% as Nvidia rally lifts TCS, Tech Mahindra, HCL Tech, Infosys
items.summary: IT stocks dominated the list of Nifty 50 gainers, with TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech and other shares jumping 2-4 percent each, sending the Nifty IT index soaring nearly 3 percent.

items.title: Buzzing Stocks: Tejas Networks advances 10% on TCS LoI; Chemplast Sanmar gains 3% on MD appointment
items.summary: Chemplast Sanmar share price added more than 3% after Ministry of Corporate Affairs has approved the appointment of Ganeshkumar Subramanian (S Ganeshkumar) as Managing Director of the company.

items.title: Momentum Stocks: Next Mediaworks, Exxaro, Tejas Networks gains up to 19% on sheer momentum
items.summary: Next Mediaworks, Just Dial, Niraj Ispat among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Today: Lenskart Solutions, Texmaco Rail, Tejas Networks, Wipro, Tempsens Instruments, NBCC, RPP Infra Projects, Adani Power in focus on 28 August
items.summary: Stocks to Watch, 28 Aug: Stocks like Lenskart Solutions, Texmaco Rail and Engineering, Tejas Networks, NBCC (India), Chemplast Sanmar, Wipro, Adani Power, RPP Infra Projects, and Tempsens Instruments (India) will be in focus on August 28.

items.title: Thermax Shares Fall Over 2% Amid Bearish Sentiment
items.summary: With the stock's last traded price at Rs 3,994.00, Thermax continues to be a closely watched entity within the Nifty Midcap 150 index.

items.title: V2 Retail: Expansion keeps growth story on track
items.summary: Improving customer retention, inventory efficiency, and store-level economics strengthen the case for sustained profitable growth

items.title: Varun Beverages shares rise 2.11% to Rs 443.00
items.summary: Varun Beverages is a constituent of the NIFTY NEXT 50 index. The stock's current price of Rs 443.00 reflects a positive movement in the market today, despite the prevailing very bearish sentiment.

items.title: Promoter Carlyle Group sells nearly 11% stake in Viyash Scientific; Invesco MF buys additional over 6% shares in Gaja Capital
items.summary: Carlyle, which as a promoter held 61.31 percent stake as of June 2026, sold 4.75 crore equity shares in Viyash Scientific for Rs 1,259.4 crore at different prices.
